messages:
Sam (Marketing): Hey team — draft of the product launch post is ready for review. Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD... Please focus on benchmark narrative and the CTA for webinar signups. TL;DR: emphasize cost/latency savings, Dedicated vs Private, and our developer-first tone.
Priya (Product): reading now; can we add a short section comparing Dedicated vs Private? Also link to the benchmarks PDF and call out typical latency/cost tradeoffs.
Miguel (Eng): small nit — numbers in paragraph 3 need units (ms). Also add a note about test rig (A100 vs A10G) so readers know context.
Jordan (Sales): Need a clear lead routing ask — add HubSpot form with routing to AE queue and UTM params. Who owns the form and the mapping to SDR/AE?
Lena (Content): I'll tidy headline; propose: "Ship LLM features faster — at predictable cost." Shorter alt: "Predictable inference for LLMs at scale."
Legal: Quick check: no customer names used; compliance looks fine but please avoid the term "guarantee" in SLA section. Add a short privacy blurb for email collection.
Eve (PM): We should mention canary rollouts and SLA tiers (best-effort vs enterprise SLA). One sentence is enough — don't overload the post.
Sam (Marketing): Updated the doc with a HubSpot form snippet and sample UTMs: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD...#draft — added a paragraph under "Get early access" explaining how leads are routed.
Sam (Marketing): Pasting CTA snippet for the blog (HTML):
```html
<form action=\"https://hooks.hubspot.com/forms/v2/submit/12345\" method=\"post\">
  <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"hutk\" value=\"{{hubspotutk}}\" />
  <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"utm_source\" value=\"blog\" />
  <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"utm_campaign\" value=\"product_launch_q2\" />
  <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"team_owner\" value=\"enterprise\" />
  <button type=\"submit\">Sign up for early access</button>
</form>
```
Priya (Product): LGTM on content after Miguel's number fix + add canary line. @Legal could you sign off on the final wording?
Legal: Approved with minor wording change: replace \"guarantee\" -> \"aim to meet\" in SLA bullet. Also add a short privacy note: "We collect email to contact you about your onboarding; we do not sell data."
Tom (Sales): :thumbsup: routing OK. We prefer hidden field team_owner=enterprise so HubSpot can auto-assign. Please also add tag "source:blog" to incoming contacts so we can filter campaign leads.
Sam (Marketing): I'll implement edits and ping again. Timeline: want final by EOD Fri for Monday publish. Anyone blocking?
Miguel (Eng): will update numbers and add test-rig footnote by EOD.
Lena (Content): headline poll in the doc — please vote by tomorrow.
Priya (Product): thanks, all — marking as in-review. /remind @Sam to follow up tomorrow at 10am
Sam (Marketing): thanks — will follow up. :rocket
